title: Just Juice Bar Below Zero Caribbean Twist 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Caribbean Twist from the Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range is a vibrant tropical mix with a chilled finish. Sweet, golden Mango leads the flavour with juicy depth, balanced by the tangy sharpness of Pineapple and a bright streak of Citrus. A layer of cool Ice completes the blend, creating a refreshing vape that captures the essence of a tropical cocktail. Formulated with nicotine salts for quick absorption and a comfortable throat feel, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod kits and vape pens. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it provides flexibility for different nicotine preferences. Produced in the UK, Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range Nic Salts are blended at a 60PG/40VG ratio, ensuring clear, bold flavour with discreet vapour output. Each flavour in the range draws on popular disposable-inspired profiles, reimagined in a convenient 10ml refill format. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
